summary: Tested NEW Rudraksha e-commerce backend + frontend + Admin Orders tab. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass. Frontend: listing (5 cards), checkout dialog (qty toggle ₹999→₹1,998, shipping form), manual fallback confirmation, admin Orders tab with Paid/Shipped/Delivered/Cancel actions all working end-to-end.

issues: Unsplash product photos do NOT depict actual Rudraksha beads. 3-Mukhi shows a gold chain/bracelet, 4-Mukhi shows gold bullion bars, 5-Mukhi shows a Christian wooden CROSS + rosary, 6-Mukhi shows an unrelated keychain-like object. This is a cultural/contextual mismatch on a Hindu spiritual product page and undermines trust. Replace with authentic Rudraksha bead photography.

Backend /admin/stats now returns rudraksha_orders_total, rudraksha_orders_paid, rudraksha_orders_pending, rudraksha_revenue_paise but the dashboard StatCard grid still only shows booking metrics. Consider surfacing Rudraksha revenue / order count as additional cards (the data is already fetched).
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add DialogDescription for accessibility.

action_items: Replace Unsplash product images on /rudraksha with actual Rudraksha bead photos (current images mis-represent the product, including a Christian cross on 5-Mukhi card).
Optional: surface rudraksha_orders_total / rudraksha_revenue_paise on admin StatCard grid (already returned by backend).
Optional: add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to CheckoutDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~840 lines and mixes models, static catalogs (SERVICES/TESTIMONIALS/RUDRAKSHA), and route handlers. Consider splitting into catalog.py / models.py / routes_*.py before it crosses 1000 lines.
RudrakshaOrderCreate.quantity has no Pydantic constraint; relies on max(1, min(qty, 10)) in handler — fine but explicit Field(ge=1, le=10) would 422 earlier with a clearer error.
/rudraksha-orders does NOT call notify_new_booking; if email/WhatsApp notifications for product orders are desired in future, wire a notify_new_order stub similar to bookings.

Frontend Razorpay SDK <script src> is not verified to be present in index.html for this page (manual fallback path works because RZP is disabled). If keys are added later, ensure checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js is loaded.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ Rudraksha orders created via API + UI for 3-Mukhi, qty=2 (amount=199800 paise). Already moved through paid → shipped/delivered/cancelled states during testing.
